interfaces.name: AXI4-Lite control subordinate
interfaces.signals: 32-bit address/data, four byte strobes and AW/W/B/AR/R channels.

interfaces.name: Cluster CSR access
interfaces.signals: AXI-Lite register write/read operations and generated register fields.

interfaces.name: LLC service window
interfaces.signals: AXI4-Lite service transactions; address map remains workbook/integration controlled.

interfaces.name: PMU configuration/status
interfaces.signals: Event ID, scope, counter enable, snapshot command and cause/status fields; exact offsets are workbook-owned.

interfaces.name: Aggregate PMU interrupt
interfaces.signals: One level interrupt asserted while an enabled sticky cause remains pending.

legend_note: The selected CSR generator version and AXI4-Lite protocol are requirements. The workbook, offsets, reset values and LLC window base remain open until the workbook is reviewed. Status codes: REUSE = upstream RTL reused; REUSE* = reuse candidate pending compatibility checks; MODIFY = source adaptation, wrapper, or macro binding; NEW = VLSIT RTL to design; GENERATED = CSR RTL from the selected generator. All proposed blocks are dashed because this cluster has no pinned integrated RTL yet.
